```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ROCR)
library(gdata)
library(vegan)
library(ggpubr)
```

```{r}
load("../../data/Mitox/ra-long.rds")
load("../../data/Mitox/ra-wide.rds")
load("../../data/Mitox/clinical.rds")
load("../../data/Mitox/mitox_microbiome_metadata.rds")
load("../../data/Mitox/counts-long.rds")
```

```{r}
# Prepare clinical data
# baseline samples 
base.samps <- mic.meta %>% 
  group_by(`Patient Id`) %>%
  arrange(Days) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(abs(Days) <= 10)

# Response ID's
resp.id <- mic.meta %>%
  left_join(demographics) %>%
  select(sample, PPI) %>%
  filter(sample %in% base.samps$sample) %>%
  mutate(PPI = if_else(is.na(PPI), 'No', as.character(PPI)))

```

# calculate alpha diversity with RA  
# shannon
```{r}
ra.in <- ra.l %>%
  filter(grepl("s__", microbe),
         sample %in% resp.id$sample)

div.ra <- ra.in %>% 
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarize(Shannon = diversity(RelAbun, index = "shannon"))

div.ra.resp <- div.ra %>%
  left_join(resp.id) %>%
  select(-sample) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!PPI,
    names_to = "Signature",
               values_to = "Score") %>%
  mutate(data.type = "RA")

div.ra.resp %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=PPI, y = Score)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = PPI)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("cornflowerblue", "deeppink4")) +
  labs(title = "Alpha Diversity", x= "PPI Use", y = "Shannon Index")
```


#calculate beta diversity
```{r}
wide_data<- ra.in %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = microbe,
              values_from = RelAbun,
              values_fill = list(Relabun = 0))

bc_dist <- vegdist(wide_data[,-1], method = "bray")


pca_result <- prcomp(bc_dist, scale. = FALSE)
scores <- data.frame(pca_result$x)
scores$Sample <- rownames(scores)
ggplot(scores, aes(x = PC1, y=PC2)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA Plot", x = "PC1", y = "PC2")
```
